specs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: production anime visual-novel hospital room background, a single landscape illustration approximately 1536x1024.
Primary request: A sunny modern Taiwanese hospital consultation / ward room, reassuring, polished and inviting.
Style/medium: Original high-quality otome-game anime background painting, clean delicate linework, soft painterly shading, rich but uncluttered environmental detail.
Scene/backdrop: A contemporary hospital room with broad windows admitting gentle daylight, soft aqua walls, a tidy hospital bed and modest consultation furnishings near the outer edges. Calm modern medical environment.
Composition/framing: Landscape canvas. Keep the central area spacious and the lower third visually quiet with generous room for dialogue UI. The center and lower areas must not be blocked by prominent furniture or objects.
Lighting/mood: Soft bright natural light, gentle warm sunlight, reassuring rather than grim.
Color palette: Bright soft aqua-blue hospital tones, ivory, subtle peach and warm gold accents.
Constraints: No people, no characters, no text, no signage, no logos, no watermarks, no interface, no frames. Entire canvas is the painted room. Production-ready game environment.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: production anime visual-novel character sprite atlas, transparent PNG RGBA, landscape canvas approximately 1536x1024.
Primary request: EXACTLY SIX separate waist-up anime character figures arranged in a STRICT uniform 3-column by 2-row grid, six equally sized rectangular tiles, with real transparent background and transparent gutters. No visible grid or tile boxes.
Style/medium: Original polished otome-game anime sprites, delicate clean linework, luminous soft cel shading, detailed adult faces, attractive mature proportions. Soft bright aqua-blue with coral, peach and gold accents; warm reassuring hospital story mood.
TOP ROW: same attractive adult East Asian male physician age 32 in all three tiles, short neat dark hair, teal scrubs under a white coat. Tile 1 neutral attentive expression; tile 2 warm smile; tile 3 tense concerned expression. All are the SAME person, SAME hair, SAME outfit, SAME front-facing waist-up pose and framing. Only expression differs.
BOTTOM ROW: same adult East Asian female caregiver daughter age 42 in all three tiles, shoulder-length chestnut hair, simple soft coral cardigan. Tile 4 neutral expression; tile 5 relieved gentle smile; tile 6 worried expression. All are the SAME person, SAME hair, SAME outfit, SAME front-facing waist-up pose and framing. Only expression differs.
Composition/framing: Each figure centered within its own tile, aligned identically with identical scale and matching head and waist baselines within each row. Each cell fully contains the entire waist-up figure including head, hair, shoulders, arms and torso. Generous clear transparent padding on every side of every figure, obvious transparent horizontal and vertical gutters. No figure touches or crosses a cell boundary. Front view, upright pose, complete shoulders and hair.
Constraints: Exactly 3 columns and exactly 2 rows; exactly six figures. True transparent alpha background, not white, not grey, no checkerboard painted into pixels. No captions, no text, no logos, no UI, no borders, no props outside silhouettes, no drop shadows beyond figures.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent character expression sprite atlas for a hospital pharmacist visual novel.
Primary request: draw ONE original fictional adult East Asian male senior pharmacist and preceptor, about age 40, repeated as three consistent expression sprites in ONE atlas.
Scene/backdrop: actual fully transparent RGBA background, no painted background, no floor, no shadows outside the character, no backdrop color or checkerboard graphic.
Subject: approachable adult male with neat short dark hair, thin rectangular eyeglasses, mature gentle facial features, white pharmacist coat over a dark teal shirt, subtle blank ID badge, holding a small clipboard against his torso. No real person's likeness and no logo.
Style/medium: warm polished otome-game anime illustration with clean elegant outlines, refined cel shading and soft highlights. Aqua/teal hospital palette with warm skin tones, attractive believable mature adult design.
Composition/framing: very wide landscape atlas, ideally 1536 by 512 pixels, aspect ratio 3:1. STRICT 3 columns by 1 row of equally sized square tiles. Left tile: neutral attentive expression. Middle tile: warmly encouraging smile. Right tile: thoughtful and mildly concerned expression. Each tile contains precisely one separate waist-up front-view portrait, centered. Same person, EXACTLY the same pose, outfit, clipboard, framing, head position, body proportions and scale across all three tiles; only eyebrows, eyes and mouth expression change. Head and torso stay upright and facing the viewer. Arrange tile centers at one sixth, one half, and five sixths of image width. Each complete portrait occupies at most 80 percent of its own square tile's width and 88 percent of its height. Keep generous REAL TRANSPARENT padding above the hair, beside the arms, and below the waist cutout of every portrait. The lower waist crop is a clean finished cutout boundary within the tile, leaving transparent space beneath. All figures and clipboard fully fit within their cells. No overlap across tile borders.
Lighting/mood: calm welcoming mentor, soft warm professional light.
Text: none. ID badge and clipboard must be blank or use indistinct nontext shapes.
Constraints: exactly three equal square cells in one horizontal row; clean true alpha cutout; no separator lines, borders, text, captions, labels, dialogue, UI, decorative objects, extra people, symbols, watermark, background, cast shadows or overlapping figures. Preserve matching identity and pose across the expressions.

Use case: identity-preserve. Adult anime visual novel expression atlas. Edit the three referenced characters into one transparent 1536x512 atlas, three equal 512x512 cells in one horizontal row. Left: Dr Wei, dark hair, white coat over teal scrubs. Middle: Mei, brown shoulder-length hair, pearl earrings, coral cardigan. Right: senior pharmacist An, glasses, white coat over dark teal shirt, existing clipboard. Change only facial expression to friendly bemused surprise: gently raised eyebrows, moderately widened eyes, slightly open mouth. Preserve adult identity, face structure, hairstyle, colors, clothes, accessories, hands, front-facing waist-up pose, scale, alignment, lighting and warm otome rendering. Characters must remain inside their own cells with transparent margins and no overlap. Genuine alpha transparency; no background, checkerboard, text, borders, symbols or watermarks.
